name: creole
description: Training-free context compaction for coding agents: Creole, a compact working language for notes, plans and replies, plus early compaction of long sessions into a small session graph of the task, the user's constraints and the current work.

headroom_tokens.title: Compaction headroom (tokens)
headroom_tokens.description: Compact once the context has grown this far past its smallest size (system prompt, tools, restored graph). Every request re-reads the whole context, so smaller is cheaper until re-reading files costs more. Empty: the skill's headroom_tokens (40000).

threshold_percent.title: Compression threshold (%)
threshold_percent.description: Never let the session grow past this share of the context window before compacting. Empty: the skill's threshold_percent (60).

context_window_tokens.title: Context window size (tokens)
context_window_tokens.description: The model's context window, for hosts that don't report it (Claude Code's function hooks read it themselves). Use 1000000 for 1M-context models.
